text_post: do 3 sets require a wing? I recently wrote a field report and someone mentioned that I shouldn't open a 3 set without wing.. how true or untrue would that statement be?

author: Radiating
text_post: 3 sets are easier than two sets without a wing. There's lots of info about going without a wing due to a special issue it creates that i'm pretty oppinionated about, but you never MUST have a wing, but a 2 set will almost never work with one, and a 3 set is hard. The hardest of all is a mixed two set without a wing.
